observations.title: Krakatau volcano (Indonesia)
observations.description: The Pusat Vulkanologi dan Mitigasi Bencana Geologi (PVMBG) reported decreasing activity at Krakatau after a large eruption in early September. A continuous eruption during 4-6 September produced lava fountains, widespread ashfall, and lava flows that advanced NW, W, and SW. Some Strombolian explosions were detected after the period of continuous activity ended, but activity generally declined over the following two weeks and deformation data indicated deflation. According to a news article, one of the three crew members from the missing boat with five journalists was found deceased. The Alert Level was lowered to 2 (on a scale of 1-4) at 1830 on 21 September and the public was advised to stay 2 km away from summit. Sources: Antara News,Pusat Vulkanologi dan Mitigasi Bencana Geologi (PVMBG, also known as CVGHM)
